subject: Catalyst CEO arrival plan — EA & ground-ops preflight
messages:
From: karthik_iyer
To: laura_bennett, tessa_morgan
Cc: evelyn_hart
Date: 2026-12-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Catalysts CEO arrival plan — EA & ground-ops preflight

Hi team,

Catalyst's CEO (Martin Hale) lands into SFO on Mon 12/14 at 10:05am (UA 783). Sonia (their EA) asked for a tight on-site schedule and an escorted transfer directly to our HQ for the 1pm strategy workshop.

Primary asks I captured from the AM sync call:
- Meet & greet at arrivals (we should have a PR/concierge card and a sign)
- Fast security screening lane + pre-printed guest badge at lobby
- Dedicated meeting room (Boardroom B) by 12:00 with AV smoke test at 11:15
- Short prep with product leads at 12:10 (coffee & one-sheeter)
- Private parking for CEO vehicle + EV charging available

Laura — can you confirm: ground escort (name), security lead for screening, and receptionist coverage?
Tessa — can you coordinate badge printing and send the arrival_manifest (names, phones, dietary) to Sonia and DirK?
Evelyn — please confirm AV tech will be onsite and run the 11:15 check. If AV can't do 11:15, propose an alternative.

I attached the latest arrival_manifest and the site access instructions. I also put a tentative parking permit (drop-off) in the Drive folder.

Goal: lock logistics by EOD so Sonia can finalize travel.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett
To: karthik_iyer, tessa_morgan
Cc: evelyn_hart
Date: 2026-12-12T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Catalysts CEO arrival plan — EA & ground-ops preflight

Karthik — thanks. Quick updates:

- Ground escort: I booked Concierge (Maya Lu) to meet at Terminal 3, door 6 at 10:35am. Maya will have a sign + walk client to the car.
- Security: Ben Carter (facility security) confirmed a fast-track for one VIP; he'll staff from 9:45–12:30. He requested the CEO's passport name (Martin Hale) and one additional name for the car driver.
- Reception: front desk will hold Boardroom B keys and direct guests to elevators; reception shift change at 11:00 is covered.
- Badge printing: Tessa — please use the "Executive — visitor" template and pre-print two copies (visitor + security). We'll keep one sealed for the CEO.

I updated arrival_manifest_v3 with car/driver details and attached parking-permit.pdf for the valet.

One open item: AV said they'll need admin network access to the meeting room laptop to run the HDMI/stream test; Evelyn, can you confirm firewall exception for that host for the 11:15 smoke test?

Laura Bennett
Senior Executive Assistant — Redwood Inference

Karthik/Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Martin prefers a brown sedan (no black) and will travel with one security officer (name: Paolo Marin). Paolo will present credentials on arrival.
- Dietary: Martin will take a vegetarian lunch (pea protein option); product leads will receive a separate menu.
- Parking: can you confirm we can keep the permit visible until 3:30pm? Our car will likely depart after the session.

Attached is our short guest register (names + mobile). If you need any additional details I can get them from Martin.

Best,
Sonia Ramirez
